info.title: Shop Admin API
info.description: Endpoints used by the admin panel.

get.description: Catalogue numbers for every staff member. The system status (services, outbox, queues, search index) only for administrators; for other roles `system` is null. A service that is down, a broker whose management API does not answer (`queues` is null) or a search index that cannot be counted (`indexedProducts` is null, `inSync` is false) does not fail the request.

200.description: The dashboard.

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

503.description: The database is unavailable, or the keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

get.description: The staff member identified by the access token of the `backoffice` realm, with any staff role.

200.description: The staff member.

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

get.description: The whole category tree, for every staff member. Siblings at every level are sorted by name (Polish collation).

200.description: Root categories with their descendants. Every node has its `slug` (unique among its siblings) and `path` (the slugs from the root to the node joined with `/`, e.g. `turystyka/biwak/namioty`). An empty catalogue gives an empty array.

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

get.description: A page of products, drafts included, sorted by name, then by id. Every staff member may read it. Page with the opaque `next` cursor as `after`; the total is not counted. The category filter includes the subcategories and the products that have the category as an additional one; an unknown category gives 404. The search term is a literal part of the name, case-insensitive.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A part of the product name, 2 to 100 characters.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only drafts or only published products.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The `next` cursor of the previous page.

200.description: A page of the product list. Possibly an empty one.

400.description: Invalid query parameters or paging cursor (problem details with `violations`).

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

404.description: The `category` filter names a category that does not exist (problem details).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

post.description: Creates a product as a draft (it is not in the store until it is published). Administrators and marketing only. The API gives the product and its new variants their ids and, for an empty `slug`, derives it from the name. A `variantId` in this body names no variant of the new product, so it is a 422. The product records the staff member of the token and the time of the change.

400.description: The body is not valid JSON (problem details).

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

403.description: The staff member is neither an administrator nor in marketing (problem details).

409.description: The slug belongs to another product (`type` slug-taken).

415.description: The body is not JSON (problem details).

422.description: A field is invalid, a category or a variant does not exist, an original of an image is not stored, or no slug can be derived from the name (problem details with `violations`, each at the path of its field).

503.description: The image storage (Garage) is unavailable, or the keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail). Nothing was saved; the request can be repeated.

get.description: A product, also a draft, as the edit form needs it, with its `version`. Every staff member may read it.

200.description: The product.

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

404.description: No such product, or the id is not a UUID (problem details).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

put.description: Replaces the whole data of the product (a form save). Administrators and marketing only. Send the `version` of the view the edit is based on: another current version is a 409 and nothing is overwritten. A successful save raises the version even when the data did not change. A row of `variants` with the `variantId` of the product keeps that variant, a row with `null` is a new one; a variant missing from the rows is removed. An empty `slug` derives it from the name, or keeps the slug once the product was published. The product records the staff member of the token and the time of the change.

200.description: The product as saved, with its new version.

400.description: The body is not valid JSON (problem details).

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

403.description: The staff member is neither an administrator nor in marketing (problem details).

404.description: No such product, or the id is not a UUID (problem details).

409.description: The `type` names the cause: product-modified (the version is not the current one), slug-taken, slug-locked (the slug of a product that was published cannot change), product-not-publishable (the last image of a published product that had images cannot be removed), variant-locked (after the first publication an axis or the meaning of a variant cannot change), variant-in-use (a removed variant has stock or reservations).

415.description: The body is not JSON (problem details).

422.description: A field is invalid, a category or a variant does not exist, an original of an image is not stored, or no slug can be derived from the name (problem details with `violations`, each at the path of its field).

503.description: The image storage (Garage) is unavailable, or the keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail). Nothing was saved; the request can be repeated.

get.description: The tax classes a product can have, with Polish names for the product form. Every staff member may read them.

200.description: The tax classes.

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

post.description: Makes a draft visible in the store; a draft needs at least one image. The first publication fixes the slug for good. Administrators and marketing only. Send the `version` of the view the action is based on: another current version is a 409 even when the product is already published. Publishing a published product changes nothing (200, same version).

200.description: The product after the action, or unchanged (with the same version) when it already was in the wanted status.

400.description: The body is not valid JSON (problem details).

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

403.description: The staff member is neither an administrator nor in marketing (problem details).

404.description: No such product, or the id is not a UUID (problem details).

409.description: The `type` names the cause: product-modified (the version is not the current one) or product-not-publishable (a draft without images).

415.description: The body is not JSON (problem details).

422.description: The `version` is missing or not a positive integer (problem details with `violations`).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

post.summary: Withdraw a product from the store
post.description: Turns a published product back into a draft: the store stops showing it. The slug stays fixed. Administrators and marketing only. Send the `version` of the view the action is based on: another current version is a 409 even when the product is already a draft. Withdrawing a draft changes nothing (200, same version).

200.description: The product after the action, or unchanged (with the same version) when it already was in the wanted status.

400.description: The body is not valid JSON (problem details).

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

403.description: The staff member is neither an administrator nor in marketing (problem details).

404.description: No such product, or the id is not a UUID (problem details).

409.description: The `type` is product-modified: the version is not the current one.

415.description: The body is not JSON (problem details).

422.description: The `version` is missing or not a positive integer (problem details with `violations`).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

post.summary: Upload the original of a product image
post.description: Stores one image file in the image storage and answers with its key and a preview. Administrators and marketing only. One file per request, in the `file` field of a `multipart/form-data` body; send several files one after another. JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF and HEIC are accepted, decided by the content and not by the name, up to 64 MB and 50 megapixels. The key follows the content, so the same file always gives the same key and is stored once. Name the key in `images[].key` of a product write; an original that no product names stays in the storage. The `detail` of a 422 is a Polish text for the staff member.

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

403.description: The staff member is neither an administrator nor in marketing (problem details).

422.description: No file was sent, the file is too large, of an unsupported type, of unreadable dimensions or of too high a resolution (problem details with a Polish `detail`). The request is too large when its `Content-Length` is above `post_max_size` (70 MB) or the file above `upload_max_filesize` (64 MB).

503.description: The image storage (Garage) is unavailable, or the keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail). Nothing was stored; the upload can be repeated.

get.description: A page of products sorted by name, then by id, each with its variants in presentation order and the stock of each variant (null when it has no stock record). Every staff member may read it. The page size counts products, each with all its variants. Page with the opaque `next` cursor as `after`; the total is not counted. The category filter includes the subcategories and the products that have the category as an additional one; an unknown category gives 404. The search term is a literal part of the name, case-insensitive.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A part of the product name, 2 to 100 characters.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The `next` cursor of the previous page.

200.description: A page of the stock list. Possibly an empty one.

400.description: Invalid query parameters or paging cursor (problem details with `violations`).

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

404.description: The `category` filter names a category that does not exist (problem details).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

post.summary: Correct the stock of a product variant
post.description: Sets the physical stock to the counted units, with a reason (a note is required for `other`). Administrators and the warehouse only. Send the `version` of the stock you saw (null for a variant without a stock record): a stock changed since then is a 409 and nothing is overwritten, so repeating a correction that succeeded is a 409 too. Counting what the stock has changes nothing: the version stays and no history entry is recorded. The history entry names the staff member of the token.

200.description: The stock as saved, or as it was when nothing changed.

400.description: The body is not valid JSON (problem details).

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

403.description: The staff member is neither an administrator nor in the warehouse (problem details).

404.description: No such variant, or the id is not a UUID (problem details).

409.description: The stock was changed since the given version, or created since the null version; or less was counted than is reserved, `detail` names the reserved units (problem details).

415.description: The body is not JSON (problem details).

422.description: The count is out of range, the reason unknown, the note too long or missing for `other`, or a key is missing or of a wrong type (problem details with `violations`).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

post.summary: Receive stock of a product variant
post.description: Adds delivered units to the physical stock. Administrators and the warehouse only. The `Idempotency-Key` identifies the receipt: sending it again with the same variant, quantity and note adds nothing and answers 200 with the current stock, so a receipt can be retried safely; the same key with other content or another variant is a 409. The history entry names the staff member of the token.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Key of the receipt, chosen by the client (e.g. a UUID made when the dialog opens): 1 to 100 characters, letters, digits, ".", "_", ":" or "-".

201.description: Received: the stock after the receipt.

200.description: The receipt was received before with this key and the same content: nothing changed, the current stock.

400.description: The `Idempotency-Key` header is missing or malformed (problem details with `violations`), or the body is not valid JSON (problem details).

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

403.description: The staff member is neither an administrator nor in the warehouse (problem details).

404.description: No such variant, or the id is not a UUID (problem details).

409.description: The key was used for a receipt with other content or of another variant (problem details).

415.description: The body is not JSON (problem details).

422.description: The quantity or the note is out of range, a key is missing or of a wrong type (problem details with `violations`), or the physical stock would exceed 1 000 000 (problem details).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

get.summary: Stock history of a product variant
get.description: Every recorded change of the stock of a product variant (receipts, corrections, reservations, releases and commits), newest first, with the deltas, the stock right after the change, what made it and, for a change by staff, who. Every staff member may read it. A variant that exists but has no stock record has an empty history. Page with the opaque `next` cursor as `after`; the total is not counted.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The `next` cursor of the previous page.

200.description: A page of the history. Possibly an empty one.

400.description: Invalid query parameters or paging cursor (problem details with `violations`).

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

404.description: No such variant, or the id is not a UUID (problem details).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

get.description: The order with its contact, address, lines, totals, the moments of its statuses, the payment that paid it, its history oldest first, its refund and its `version`, which the next change of the status or the completion of the refund sends. `allowedTransitions` and `canCompleteRefund` say what the staff member of the token may do with it now. Administrators, support and the warehouse only.

200.description: The order.

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

403.description: The staff member may not see orders (problem details).

404.description: No such order, or the id is not a UUID (problem details).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

get.description: A page of orders, newest first (then by id); with `refund=pending` only the orders with a refund to do, the nearest due date first (then by id), with `overdue` for the ones past it. The status filter and the search combine with it. The search is an exact order number (`R-100001`, any letter case) or an exact email (any letter case); anything else finds nothing. Page with the opaque `nextCursor` as `after`, with the same filters; the total is not counted. Administrators, support and the warehouse only.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only the orders in this status.

parameters.name: refund
parameters.description: `pending`: only the orders with a refund to do, nearest due date first.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: An order number or an email, exact, any letter case; 1 to 254 characters once trimmed.

200.description: A page of the list. Possibly an empty one.

400.description: Invalid query parameters or paging cursor, also a cursor of the other sort (problem details with `violations`).

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

403.description: The staff member may not see orders (problem details).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

post.summary: Change the status of an order
post.description: Ships (the reserved units leave the stock), delivers, cancels (a paid order only; the reservation is released and a refund of the gross total is due in 14 days) or registers the return of an order (shipped or delivered; a refund is due in 14 days, the stock stays). Administrators and the warehouse ship and deliver, administrators and support cancel and register returns. A note is required to cancel and to register a return. Send the `version` of the order you saw: an order changed since then is a 409 and nothing is changed, so repeating a change that succeeded is a 409 too. The history entry names the staff member of the token. The customer gets an email about a shipment, a cancellation and a return.

200.description: The order as saved.

400.description: The body is not valid JSON (problem details).

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

403.description: The staff member may not see orders, or may not make this change (problem details).

404.description: No such order, or the id is not a UUID (problem details).

409.description: The order changed since the given version, or its status does not allow the change (problem details with a stable `type`, see `BackofficeOrderConflictProblem`). Nothing is changed.

415.description: The body is not JSON (problem details).

422.description: The transition is unknown, the version is not an integer of at least 1, the note breaks its rules or is missing to cancel or register a return, or a key is missing or of a wrong type (problem details with Polish `violations`).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

post.summary: Mark the refund of an order made
post.description: Marks the refund to do of an order (cancelled by staff or returned) as made, with the staff member of the token, the moment and an optional note; the money itself is transferred by hand, outside the system. The status of the order stays and no history entry is added. Administrators and support only. Send the `version` of the order you saw: an order changed since then is a 409, so repeating a completion that succeeded is a 409 too.

200.description: The order as saved.

400.description: The body is not valid JSON (problem details).

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

403.description: The staff member is neither an administrator nor in support (problem details).

404.description: No such order, or the id is not a UUID (problem details).

409.description: The order changed since the given version, or it has no refund to do (problem details with a stable `type`, see `BackofficeOrderConflictProblem`). Nothing is changed.

415.description: The body is not JSON (problem details).

422.description: The version is not an integer of at least 1, the note breaks its rules, or a key is missing or of a wrong type (problem details with Polish `violations`).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

get.description: A page of products sorted by name, then by id, each with its variants in presentation order and the price of each variant (null when it has none). Every staff member may read it. The page size counts products, each with all its variants. Page with the opaque `next` cursor as `after`; the total is not counted. The category filter includes the subcategories and the products that have the category as an additional one; an unknown category gives 404. The search term is a literal part of the name, case-insensitive.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A part of the product name, 2 to 100 characters.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The `next` cursor of the previous page.

200.description: A page of the price list. Possibly an empty one.

400.description: Invalid query parameters or paging cursor (problem details with `violations`).

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

404.description: The `category` filter names a category that does not exist (problem details).

put.summary: Change the price of a product variant
put.description: Sets the gross price of one variant; the API computes the net and the VAT at the current rate of the price's tax class (the class of the variant's product for a first price). Administrators only. Send the `version` of the price you saw (null for a variant without a price): a price changed since then is a 409 and nothing is overwritten. The same gross at the same rate changes nothing: the version stays and no history entry is recorded. The history entry names the staff member of the token. The price of a variant in an active promotion does not change.

200.description: The price as saved, or as it was when nothing changed.

400.description: The body is not valid JSON (problem details).

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

403.description: The staff member is not an administrator (problem details).

404.description: No such variant, or the id is not a UUID (problem details).

409.description: The variant is in an active promotion (`price-locked-by-promotion`, whatever the version: end the promotion first), or the price was changed since the given version, or created since the null version (`about:blank`); see `PricingConflictProblem`. Nothing is changed.

415.description: The body is not JSON (problem details).

422.description: The gross is out of range or a key is missing or of a wrong type (problem details with `violations`).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

get.description: A page of the discount codes, newest first (then by id), with the status at the time of the server and the number of active usages. Every staff member may read it. Page with the opaque `next` cursor as `after`, with the same filters; the total is not counted.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only the codes in this status now.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The beginning of the code, in any case; trimmed, 1 to 32 characters. One with a character no code has gives an empty page.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The `next` cursor of the previous page.

200.description: A page of the list. Possibly an empty one.

400.description: Invalid query parameters or paging cursor (problem details with `violations`).

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

post.description: Creates a percent or an amount code with its period, minimum order and usage limit. Administrators and marketing only. The text is unique among all codes for ever, without regard to case. The code names the staff member of the token.

400.description: The body is not valid JSON (problem details).

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

403.description: The staff member may not change discount codes (problem details).

409.description: Another code has the same text (`discount-code-taken`, see `PricingConflictProblem`). Nothing is changed.

415.description: The body is not JSON (problem details).

422.description: A field is invalid, a key is missing or of a wrong type (problem details with `violations`, each at its field, with a Polish `title`).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

get.description: A discount code with its status at the time of the server and the number of its active usages. Every staff member may read it.

200.description: The discount code.

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

404.description: No such discount code, also an id that is not a UUID (problem details).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

put.description: Sends the whole code as it should be (its text never changes), based on the `version` seen. Administrators and marketing only. Until its start a code changes everything. Once started (also disabled or expired) only its end, `enabled` and an existing limit change: another kind, value, minimum or start, or a limit for a code without one, is a 409 `discount-code-not-editable`. A limit is never below the active usages, and a changed end is after the time of the server (422; stopping a code at once is disabling it). An unknown code is a 404 before the body is read.

200.description: The code as saved.

400.description: The body is not valid JSON (problem details).

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

403.description: The staff member may not change discount codes (problem details).

404.description: No such discount code, also an id that is not a UUID (problem details).

409.description: The code changed since the given version (`about:blank`) or the change is not allowed once the code started (`discount-code-not-editable`); see `PricingConflictProblem`. Nothing is changed.

415.description: The body is not JSON (problem details).

422.description: A field is invalid, a key is missing or of a wrong type, the limit is below the active usages or a changed end is not after now (problem details with `violations`).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

get.summary: Price history of a product variant
get.description: Every recorded change of the price of a product variant, newest first, with the price as it was set, what made the change and, for a change by staff, who. Every staff member may read it. A variant that exists but never had a price has an empty history. Page with the opaque `next` cursor as `after`; the total is not counted.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The `next` cursor of the previous page.

200.description: A page of the history. Possibly an empty one.

400.description: Invalid query parameters or paging cursor (problem details with `violations`).

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

404.description: No such variant, or the id is not a UUID (problem details).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

get.description: A promotion with its variants (product, name and label from the catalog) and their catalog and promotional prices. Every staff member may read it.

200.description: The promotion.

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

404.description: No such promotion, also an id that is not a UUID (problem details).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

put.description: Sends the whole promotion as it should be, based on the `version` seen. Administrators and marketing only. A planned promotion changes everything. An active one changes only its name and its end: any other value different from the stored one is a 409 `promotion-not-editable`, and an end at or before the time of the server ends it at once (the next whole second; "end now" sends the time of the browser). An ended promotion changes no more. A period overlapping another promotion with a common variant is a 409 `promotion-overlap`; a variant the promotion gains must exist in the catalog and have a current price.

200.description: The promotion as saved.

400.description: The body is not valid JSON (problem details).

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

403.description: The staff member may not change promotions (problem details).

404.description: No such promotion, also an id that is not a UUID (problem details).

409.description: The promotion changed since the given version (`about:blank`), its status does not allow the change (`promotion-not-editable`), or variants are in another promotion of an overlapping period (`promotion-overlap`); see `PricingConflictProblem`. Nothing is changed.

415.description: The body is not JSON (problem details).

422.description: A field is invalid, a key is missing or of a wrong type, or an added variant does not exist or has no current price (problem details with `violations`, a variant at `variantIds[<index>]`).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

delete.description: Deletes a promotion that has not started, based on the `version` seen. Administrators and marketing only. An active or ended promotion is kept for ever (409 `promotion-not-editable`); end an active one with a change of its end.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: The `version` of the promotion the deletion is based on.

400.description: The version is missing or not a positive integer (problem details with `violations`).

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

403.description: The staff member may not change promotions (problem details).

404.description: No such promotion, also an id that is not a UUID (problem details).

409.description: The promotion changed since the given version (`about:blank`) or is not planned (`promotion-not-editable`); see `PricingConflictProblem`. Nothing is changed.

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

get.description: A page of promotions, newest start first (then by id), with the status at the time of the server. Every staff member may read it. Page with the opaque `next` cursor as `after`, with the same filter; the total is not counted.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only the promotions in this status now.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The `next` cursor of the previous page.

200.description: A page of the list. Possibly an empty one.

400.description: Invalid query parameters or paging cursor (problem details with `violations`).

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

post.description: Plans a percent off on a list of variants for a period. Administrators and marketing only. A variant is in at most one promotion at any moment: a period overlapping another promotion with a common variant is a 409 that lists the variants. Every variant must exist in the catalog and have a current price. The promotion names the staff member of the token.

400.description: The body is not valid JSON (problem details).

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

403.description: The staff member may not change promotions (problem details).

409.description: Variants are in another promotion of an overlapping period (`promotion-overlap` with `conflictingVariantIds`, see `PricingConflictProblem`). Nothing is changed.

415.description: The body is not JSON (problem details).

422.description: A field is invalid, a key is missing or of a wrong type, or a variant does not exist or has no current price (problem details with `violations`, each at the path of its field, a variant at `variantIds[<index>]`).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

detail.description: Present only for 4xx errors, never for 5xx.

violations.description: Present only for 400 (invalid query parameters) or 422 (invalid request body) caused by invalid input.

BackofficeOrderList.description: A page of the order list.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor of the next page (send it as `after` with the same filters), null on the last page.

BackofficeOrderListItem.description: An order in the list. Amounts in grosze.

itemCount.description: Units of all lines of the order.

refund.description: The refund of an order cancelled by staff or returned; null for any other order.

amount.description: The gross total of the order, in grosze, in its currency.

dueAt.description: The refund is to be made by this moment, 14 days after the cancellation or the return (RFC 3339, UTC).

completedAt.description: When a staff member marked it made (RFC 3339, UTC); null while it is to do.

overdue.description: Still to do past `dueAt`, computed by the API.

BackofficeOrderStatus.description: `new` (waits for the payment), `paid`, `shipped`, `delivered`, `cancelled` (unpaid in time, or by staff), `returned`.

BackofficeOrderTransition.description: A change of the status by staff: `ship` (paid → shipped), `deliver` (shipped → delivered), `cancel` (paid → cancelled, a refund to do), `return` (shipped or delivered → returned, a refund to do).

BackofficeOrder.description: An order with everything the panel shows of it, copies of the names and prices of its placement included. Amounts in grosze; moments in RFC 3339 and UTC, null until the status they belong to.

version.description: The version to send with the next change of the status or the completion of the refund.

discount.description: The discount code the order was placed with; null without one.

paymentDeadline.description: An order still `new` past this moment is cancelled.

paidAt.description: Stays after a cancellation by staff and a return.

paymentId.description: The payment that paid the order (the one to refund); stays after a cancellation by staff and a return.

deliveredAt.description: Null also for an order returned without being delivered.

cancellationReason.description: `payment_timeout` (unpaid in time) or `staff`; null unless cancelled.

history.description: Every change of the status, oldest first.

refund.description: The refund of an order cancelled by staff or returned; null for any other order.

allowedTransitions.description: The changes of the status the staff member of the token may make now (the status allows them and so do their roles).

canCompleteRefund.description: The refund is to do and the staff member of the token may mark it made.

variantLabel.description: The values of the variant joined with ", "; empty for the default variant of a product without variant axes.

unitGross.description: Gross price of one unit in grosze (the effective price, with a promotion if any).

grossBeforeDiscount.description: Unit gross price × quantity, in grosze, before the discount of the code.

discountGross.description: The share of the line in the discount of the code, in grosze; 0 without a code.

lineGross.description: The value of the line after the discount (`grossBeforeDiscount` − `discountGross`), in grosze.

promotion.description: The promotion that gave the unit price when the order was placed; null without one.

BackofficeOrderLinePromotion.description: The copy of a promotion in a line of an order.

regularUnitGross.description: The catalog gross price of one unit the percent was taken off, in grosze.

BackofficeOrderDiscount.description: The copy of the discount code of an order, as it was when the order was placed.

value.description: The percent (1–90) of a `percent` code, the amount in grosze of an `amount` code.

amountGross.description: The discount of the order in grosze, the sum of `discountGross` of its lines.

BackofficeOrderTotals.description: Sums of the lines after the discount of the code; net + vat = gross.

BackofficeOrderStatusChange.description: An entry of the history. Only a change by `staff` names the staff member, and only it may have a note.

actorType.description: `customer` (the placement, also by a guest), `system` (the payment, the expiry), `staff`.

BackofficeOrderRefund.description: The money the order owes the customer back; made by hand outside the system, then marked made.

amount.description: The gross total of the order, in grosze.

dueAt.description: 14 days after the cancellation or the return.

overdue.description: Still to do past `dueAt`, computed by the API.

completedAt.description: Null while it is to do.

BackofficeOrderConflictProblem.description: A 409 of the order endpoints of the panel. `type` names the cause (the `detail` is Polish text for people and may change): the status of the order does not allow the change, the order has no refund to do, or (`about:blank`) the order changed since the `version` sent, also when a change that succeeded is sent again. Nothing is changed.

detail.description: Polish text for the staff member.

PricingConflictProblem.description: A 409 of the prices, promotions and discount codes of the panel. `type` names the cause (the `detail` is Polish text for people and may change): the price of a variant in an active promotion cannot change (end the promotion first), variants are in another promotion of an overlapping period (listed in `conflictingVariantIds`), the status of the promotion does not allow the change (after its start only the name and the end, an ended one not at all, only a planned one is deleted), another discount code has the same text, the change of a started discount code is not allowed (only its end, `enabled` and an existing limit change), or (`about:blank`) the price, the promotion or the discount code changed since the `version` sent. Nothing is changed.

detail.description: Polish text for the staff member.

conflictingVariantIds.description: Only with `promotion-overlap`. The variants of the request that are in another promotion of an overlapping period, ordered by id.

ProductConflictProblem.description: A 409 of the product endpoints. `type` names the cause (the `detail` is Polish text for people and may change): the product changed since the given version, the slug belongs to another product, the slug is locked since the first publication, the product cannot be published (a draft without images) or lose its last image once published, an axis or the meaning of a variant cannot change after the first publication, or a removed variant has stock or reservations.

detail.description: Polish text for the staff member.

CreateProductRequest.description: The data of a new product. The product is a draft.

slug.description: Slug: lower-case letters without Polish diacritics, digits and single dashes. Empty: the API derives it from the name (or keeps it once the product was published). Changeable only until the first publication.

shortDescription.description: Short description, up to 500 characters; may be empty.

mainCategoryId.description: Id of the main category; an unknown category is a 422 at this field.

additionalCategoryIds.description: Ids of up to 10 additional categories, different from each other and from the main one.

taxClass.description: Code of the tax class, one of `GET /tax-classes`.

images.description: Up to 10 images in presentation order (the first one is the main one), each an original stored by `POST /product-images`; a key is used once.

variantAxes.description: Names of up to 2 variant axes, 1 to 30 characters, without a colon, different without regard to case.

variants.description: The variants in presentation order: one row per variant with one value per axis (1 to 40 characters); exactly one row without values for a product without axes. A row with the `variantId` of the product keeps that variant, a row with `null` is a new one. No two rows have the same values without regard to case and spaces at the ends.

UpdateProductRequest.description: The whole data of the product and the version it is based on.

version.description: The `version` of the product the edit is based on; another current version is a 409.

slug.description: Slug: lower-case letters without Polish diacritics, digits and single dashes. Empty: the API derives it from the name (or keeps it once the product was published). Changeable only until the first publication.

shortDescription.description: Short description, up to 500 characters; may be empty.

mainCategoryId.description: Id of the main category; an unknown category is a 422 at this field.

additionalCategoryIds.description: Ids of up to 10 additional categories, different from each other and from the main one.

taxClass.description: Code of the tax class, one of `GET /tax-classes`.

images.description: Up to 10 images in presentation order (the first one is the main one), each an original stored by `POST /product-images`; a key is used once.

variantAxes.description: Names of up to 2 variant axes, 1 to 30 characters, without a colon, different without regard to case.

variants.description: The variants in presentation order: one row per variant with one value per axis (1 to 40 characters); exactly one row without values for a product without axes. A row with the `variantId` of the product keeps that variant, a row with `null` is a new one. No two rows have the same values without regard to case and spaces at the ends.

PublicationRequest.description: The version of the product the action is based on.

version.description: The `version` of the product the action is based on; another current version is a 409.

CorrectStockRequest.description: The counted physical stock of a product variant, based on the version of the stock the staff member saw.

physical.description: Units counted on the shelf, from 0 to 1 000 000; not less than is reserved.

version.description: The `version` of the stock the correction is based on; null when the variant has no stock record.

reason.description: Why: inventory count, damage, loss or another reason (explained in the note).

note.description: A note, at most 500 characters once trimmed, without control characters other than tab and line breaks; required for the reason `other`, otherwise null or blank for none.

ReceiveStockRequest.description: Delivered units of a product variant.

quantity.description: Units received, from 1 to 100 000. The physical stock may not exceed 1 000 000.

note.description: A note, at most 500 characters once trimmed, without control characters other than tab and line breaks; null or blank for none.
note.example: Dostawa od Biegam sp. z o.o.

ChangeOrderStatusRequest.description: A change of the status of an order, based on the version of the order the staff member saw.

transition.description: `ship` (paid → shipped), `deliver` (shipped → delivered), `cancel` (paid → cancelled, a refund to do), `return` (shipped or delivered → returned, a refund to do).

version.description: The `version` of the order the change is based on.

note.description: One line, at most 500 characters once trimmed, without control characters; required for `cancel` and `return`, otherwise null or blank for none.

CompleteRefundRequest.description: The refund of an order marked made, based on the version of the order the staff member saw.

version.description: The `version` of the order the completion is based on.

note.description: One line, at most 500 characters once trimmed, without control characters; null or blank for none.

ChangePriceRequest.description: A new gross price, based on the version of the price the staff member saw.

gross.description: Gross price (VAT included) in grosze, from 1 (0,01 zł) to 99 999 999 (999 999,99 zł).

version.description: The `version` of the price the change is based on; null when the variant has no price yet.

name.description: 1 to 100 characters once trimmed, without control characters.

percentOff.description: The discount of every variant, in percent.

startsAt.description: RFC 3339 with a time zone. Null, now or a moment before now: the promotion starts now (at the next whole second). A fraction of a second is cut.

endsAt.description: RFC 3339 with a time zone, after now and the start, at most 90 days after the start. The promotion is in force until before this moment. A fraction of a second is cut.

variantIds.description: 1 to 1000 variants, each once; every one must exist in the catalog and have a current price.

RevisePromotionRequest.description: A promotion as it should be. Once started only the name and the end may differ from the stored values.

name.description: 1 to 100 characters once trimmed, without control characters.

percentOff.description: The discount of every variant, in percent. Fixed once the promotion started.

startsAt.description: RFC 3339 with a time zone; null, now or before now starts a planned promotion now. Fixed once the promotion started (send the stored one).

endsAt.description: RFC 3339 with a time zone, at most 90 days after the start. For an active promotion, now or before now ends it at once ("end now": the next whole second).

variantIds.description: 1 to 1000 variants, each once. Fixed once the promotion started; an added one must exist in the catalog and have a current price.

version.description: The `version` of the promotion the change is based on.

DashboardServiceResponse.description: The state of one service of the stack.

latencyMs.description: How long the service took to answer, in milliseconds. Null when it is down.

pending.description: Events waiting to be relayed to the broker.

DashboardQueueResponse.description: A queue of the message broker.

consumers.description: Number of AMQP subscribers (basic.consume) of the queue, as reported by RabbitMQ. The Messenger worker polls with basic.get instead of subscribing, so this is 0 even while the worker runs: it says nothing about the worker.

DashboardSearchIndexResponse.description: The search index compared with the catalogue.

indexedProducts.description: Documents in the index. Null when the index cannot be counted.

inSync.description: Whether both numbers are equal. False when the index cannot be counted.

DashboardSystemResponse.description: The state of the system, for administrators.

services.description: Always in this order: postgres, redis, elasticsearch, rabbitmq, keycloak, garage, imgproxy, mailpit. A service that does not answer within 1 s is down.

queues.description: Queues of the broker. Null when its management API does not answer.

system.description: Null unless the staff member is an administrator.

StaffMeResponse.description: The staff member identified by the access token.

id.description: Staff member id, the `sub` of the token.

roles.description: Staff roles, without any other realm role.

ImageViewResponse.description: An image in the `thumbnail` size with signed URLs of its variants.

aspectRatio.description: Width to height of every variant.

variants.description: Signed URLs by output format (the file extension), widths ascending.

ProductListItemResponse.description: A row of the product list of the panel.

status.description: A draft is seen only in the panel.

variantCount.description: The number of variants (1 for a product without axes).

image.description: The main image in the `thumbnail` size; null for a product without images.

ProductListResponse.description: A page of the product list of the panel.

next.description: Opaque cursor of the next page (send it as `after`), null on the last page.

ProductEditImageResponse.description: An image of a product in the edit view.

ProductEditVariantResponse.description: A variant of a product in the edit view.

values.description: One value per axis, in the order of the axes; empty for the default variant of a product without axes.

ProductEditViewResponse.description: A product as the edit form needs it, with the `version` a save is based on.

version.description: Version of the product: send it back with a save, a publication or a withdrawal.

firstPublishedAt.description: When the product was first published (RFC 3339); null while it never was.

slugLocked.description: The slug cannot change: the product was published at least once.

images.description: In presentation order; the first one is the main image.

TaxClassResponse.description: A tax class a product can have.

ImagePreviewResponse.description: A preview of an uploaded original: the `thumbnail` size with signed URLs of its variants.

aspectRatio.description: Width to height of every variant.

variants.description: Signed URLs by output format (the file extension), widths ascending.

level.description: Availability level shown in the store.

version.description: Version of the stock, to send with a correction.

updatedAt.description: When the stock last changed (RFC 3339, UTC).

label.description: The values of the variant joined by ", "; empty for the default variant of a product without variant axes.

next.description: Opaque cursor of the next page (send it as `after`), null on the last page.

version.description: Version of the stock, to send with a correction; null when the variant has no stock record.

DiscountCodeResponse.description: A discount code. Times in UTC (RFC 3339), whole seconds; the code is valid in [startsAt, endsAt).

value.description: The percent (1 to 90) for `percent`, the amount in grosze (100 to 1 000 000) for `amount`.

activeUses.description: The usages of orders that are not cancelled unpaid.

status.description: From the time of the server: disabled (whatever the period), planned before the start, active until before the end, expired after.

version.description: Version of the code, for the optimistic locking of changes.

DiscountCodeListResponse.description: A page of the discount codes, newest first.

next.description: Opaque cursor of the next page (send it as `after`), null on the last page.

code.description: Once trimmed, 3 to 32 characters: letters A–Z, digits and the dash, in any case (stored in upper case). Unique among all codes for ever, without regard to case; it never changes.

kind.description: A percent of the order or an amount.

value.description: The percent (1 to 90) for `percent`, the amount in grosze (100 to 1 000 000, 1 to 10 000 zł) for `amount`.

minimumOrderGross.description: The smallest order (gross of the effective prices, before the code, in grosze) the code works from; required and greater than the amount for `amount`.

startsAt.description: RFC 3339 with a time zone; a moment in the past makes the code active at once. A fraction of a second is cut.

endsAt.description: RFC 3339 with a time zone, after the start; the code is valid until before this moment. Null: no end. A fraction of a second is cut.

usageLimit.description: How many orders in total may use the code (orders cancelled unpaid give their use back). Null: no limit.

enabled.description: A disabled code gives no discount whatever its period.

kind.description: A percent of the order or an amount. Fixed once the code started.

value.description: The percent (1 to 90) for `percent`, the amount in grosze (100 to 1 000 000) for `amount`. Fixed once the code started.

minimumOrderGross.description: In grosze; required and greater than the amount for `amount`. Fixed once the code started.

startsAt.description: RFC 3339 with a time zone. Fixed once the code started (send the stored one).

endsAt.description: RFC 3339 with a time zone, after the start; a changed end must be after the time of the server (stopping a code at once is disabling it). Null: no end.

usageLimit.description: Not below the active usages. Once the code started a limit may change or be removed (null), but not be added.

version.description: The `version` of the code the change is based on.

currency.description: The ISO 4217 currency code of the amounts.

taxClass.description: The tax class of the price at the time.

source.description: What made the change: `staff` (a staff member in the panel), `seed` (the demo data) or `tax_reconciliation` (a repair after a rate change).

PriceHistoryResponse.description: A page of the price history of a product variant, newest change first.

next.description: Opaque cursor of the next page (send it as `after`), null on the last page.

productName.description: Null for a variant deleted from the catalog.

regularGross.description: The current catalog gross in grosze; null without a current price.

promotionalGross.description: The gross in the promotion in grosze; null without a catalog price and for an ended promotion (what was paid is in the orders).

status.description: From the time of the server.
